title: This Fish Shoots Down Insects From 10 Feet Away

scenes.text: This fish shoots down insects from ten feet away.
The archerfish spits a jet of water at bugs up to three meters above.
Light bends at the surface, but it corrects for that when it aims.
Adults usually hit on the very first shot.
Young fish learn by practicing, and even by watching others.
A fish with perfect aim. Watch that spit again.

description:
The archerfish can knock insects off branches up to about ten feet above the water.
It compensates for the way light bends at the surface, and adults usually hit on the first shot.
Would your aim be this good?
first_comment: What's the best animal hunter you know of?
